processes.calpine_nomination_intake: Receive the recurring Calpine daily/monthly gas nomination document by email and key or confirm it into the nomination and scheduling systems.
processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_resolution: Investigate meters that flowed without a deal, contract or nomination, then roll or create the deal or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for-gas.
processes.deal_correction_request: Fix deals that are missing, on the wrong counterparty or unbilled after a counterparty or customer raises it, often with payment deadline pressure.
processes.meter_volume_change_coordination: Relay and apply changes to expected meter or plant volumes from producers and schedulers so nominations and balances stay correct.
processes.cost_center_allocation_reporting: Respond to recurring finance and cost-center requests for budgets, allocations, activity surveys and charge checks.
processes.imbalance_and_contract_cleanup_followup: Chase pipeline imbalance, netting and contract reconciliation questions and reports.
